questions.q: Look back at your notes from lesson one: how has your thinking changed?
questions.answer: One example: "At the start I wasn't sure faith and reason fit together. Now I can give real reasons for what I believe, even though I still have questions."

questions.q: Which of your early questions about faith got answered, and which remain?
questions.answer: One example: "I now see why evil doesn't disprove God, but I still wrestle with hell." The lesson says having more questions now is normal; keep seeking answers.

questions.q: What part could you play in helping a friend come to know Jesus?
questions.answer: One example: being the friend who listens, asks good questions and stays kind, even if someone else leads them to Jesus. Some plant, some water, but God gives the growth.
